title: Arthur742Ramos/GraphCoveringTheory
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
summary: Formalizes the sharp Schreier index formula for a finite-index subgroup of a free group on a finite nonempty generating type. For a finite nonempty type alpha, a subgroup H of FreeGroup alpha with finite index d is proved equivalent, as a group, to FreeGroup (Fin (1 + d * (card alpha - 1))). More strongly, the repository exposes a FreeGroupBasis for H with this indexing type. review.reason: Lean formalization of the sharp Schreier index formula for free group subgroups.
